description: End-to-end 5G UDM/UDR subscriber profile lifecycle management, including provisioning, querying, updating, policy changes, rollback, and audit.

subscriber_id.description: Internal unique subscriber identifier in the UDM domain (e.g., CRM ID or IMSI surrogate).

imsi.description: International Mobile Subscriber Identity associated with the subscriber.

profile_id.description: Identifier for a specific subscriber profile version stored in UDR.

transaction_id.description: Identifier for multi-step provisioning or rollback transactions.

network_slice_id.description: Identifier of a 5G network slice (S-NSSAI) associated with the subscriber.

policy_profile_id.description: Identifier for a subscriber policy profile used by PCF/UDM.

udm_node_id.description: Identifier of a specific UDM instance or cluster.

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: initiate_subscriber_provisioning
functions.description: Initiate a new subscriber provisioning transaction, reserving identifiers and validating basic data before committing into UDM/UDR.

subscriber_basic.description: Basic subscriber attributes required for provisioning.

imsi.description: Requested IMSI value; may be auto-assigned if omitted.

msisdn.description: Primary phone number associated with the subscriber.

service_type.description: High-level type of service the subscriber is provisioned for.

initial_subscription_data.description: Initial subscription data to be stored in UDR/UDM.

access_restrictions.description: Access restriction categories applied to the subscriber.

default_network_slices.description: Default network slices to which the subscriber will be attached.

priority.description: Priority of this slice for the subscriber.

amf_registration_allowed.description: Whether the subscriber is allowed to register to AMF by default.

policy_binding.description: Initial policy profile bindings for PCF/UDM.

validation_options.description: Options that influence how validation is performed.

validate_imsi_uniqueness.description: Whether to verify IMSI is not already assigned.

allow_reserved_msisdn_ranges.description: If true, permits MSISDNs in reserved ranges.

strict_schema_validation.description: If true, reject unknown fields or invalid enums.

requested_by.description: Context of the system or operator initiating provisioning.

operator_id.description: Human operator ID performing the action, if applicable.

functions.returns: Transaction ID, preliminary subscriber_id and imsi (if reserved), and validation status with any warnings or errors.

functions.name: check_subscriber_conflicts
functions.description: Check for conflicts in identifiers and subscription data before committing provisioning changes into UDM.

transaction_id.description: Provisioning transaction ID returned by initiate_subscriber_provisioning.

checks.description: Set of conflict checks to execute.

identifier_conflicts.description: Check for existing subscribers with same IMSI/MSISDN.

slice_conflicts.description: Verify that requested slices are available and not restricted.

policy_conflicts.description: Validate policy profile compatibility with service type and region.

conflict_resolution_strategy.description: Strategy to apply when conflicts are detected.

functions.returns: Conflict analysis including lists of blocking and non-blocking conflicts, suggested resolutions, and updated transaction status.

functions.name: commit_subscriber_profile
functions.description: Commit a validated subscriber profile and subscription data into UDM/UDR, making it active.

activation_mode.description: Whether the subscriber should be activated now or at a scheduled time.

udm_node_preference.description: Preferences for which UDM cluster or node will host the profile.

udm_node_id.description: Explicit UDM node to target; overrides preferred_region.

allow_cross_region_fallback.description: Allow fallback to a different region if preferred is unavailable.

change_ticket.description: External change ticket or order ID.

functions.returns: Final subscriber_id, profile_id, effective activation time, and UDM node assignment.

functions.name: get_subscriber_profile
functions.description: Retrieve a subscriber profile from UDM/UDR with optional filtering of data domains and versions.

subscriber_ref.description: Reference to the subscriber, using either subscriber_id or IMSI.

profile_version.description: Specific profile version ID; if omitted, the latest active version is returned.

include_sections.description: Profile sections to include in response.

mask_sensitive_fields.description: If true, sensitive fields such as authentication data are masked.

functions.returns: Complete or partial subscriber profile, including identifiers, subscription details, policy bindings, slices, and metadata.

functions.name: search_subscribers
functions.description: Search for subscribers based on identifiers, slice memberships, policy profiles, and status.

imsi_prefix.description: Match subscribers whose IMSI starts with this prefix.

service_type.description: Filter by one or more service types.

network_slice_ids.description: Match subscribers attached to any of the specified network slices.

policy_profile_ids.description: Filter by policy profiles assigned to the subscriber.

created_between.description: Filter by profile creation timestamp range.

pagination.description: Pagination options for large result sets.

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscribers with lightweight profile summaries and total result count.

functions.name: update_subscriber_policy
functions.description: Update subscriber-specific policy bindings and overrides for UDM/PCF.

base_policy_profile_id.description: New base policy profile; if omitted, base profile remains unchanged.

overrides_to_add_or_update.description: Policy override key-value pairs to add or update.

overrides_to_remove.description: List of override keys to remove.

effective_time.description: Control when the policy changes should take effect.

scheduled_time.description: Time at which changes should be applied if mode is 'scheduled'.

reason.description: Business or operational reason for policy change.

functions.returns: New policy_profile_id (if changed), updated override set, and effective_time_details.

functions.name: modify_network_slice_assignments
functions.description: Add, update, or remove network slice assignments for a subscriber.

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber identifier whose slice assignments are being modified.

slices_to_add_or_update.description: Network slices to add or update.

allowed_dnn_list.description: List of allowed DNNs (data network names) for this slice.

slices_to_remove.description: Network slice IDs to remove from subscriber assignments.

conflict_handling.description: Defines how to handle conflicts with existing assignments.

functions.returns: Updated list of network_slice_ids with their parameters and any conflicts that were skipped.

functions.name: suspend_or_resume_subscriber
functions.description: Suspend or resume a subscriber in UDM, affecting registration and service availability.

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber identifier whose lifecycle state is changing.

action.description: Whether to suspend or resume the subscriber.

expected_resume_time.description: Planned time to resume services, if known.

resume_reason.description: Operator or system reason for resuming services.

force_registration_refresh.description: If true, triggers a network-wide registration refresh.

functions.returns: Updated subscriber status, effective time of change, and any network actions triggered.

functions.name: check_udm_node_health_and_capacity
functions.description: Check health and capacity of UDM nodes or clusters before placing or migrating subscriber profiles.

target.description: Target UDM node or region to evaluate.

udm_node_id.description: Specific UDM node ID to check.

region.description: Region identifier to evaluate aggregated capacity.

include_metrics.description: Metrics to include in the response.

functions.returns: Health status (healthy/degraded/unavailable), current metrics, and whether capacity thresholds are exceeded.

functions.name: migrate_subscriber_profile
functions.description: Migrate a subscriber profile between UDM nodes or regions for load balancing or resilience.

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber whose profile should be migrated.

target_udm.description: Target UDM location for the profile.

udm_node_id.description: Explicit UDM node ID to migrate to.

region.description: Target region name if specific node is not provided.

dry_run.description: If true, only simulate migration and return impact analysis.

functions.returns: Migration transaction_id, source and target UDM nodes, status (or simulation results if dry_run=true).

functions.name: rollback_subscriber_change
functions.description: Rollback subscriber-related changes using a prior transaction_id or profile_id snapshot.

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber identifier whose changes should be rolled back.

rollback_reference.description: Reference identifying the change to rollback.

scope.description: Defines which portions of the subscriber profile are rolled back.

force.description: If true, perform rollback even if intermediate changes exist, recording them as superseded.

functions.returns: New profile_id after rollback, details of reverted fields, and any conflicts that could not be reverted.

functions.name: retry_failed_udm_operation
functions.description: Retry a previously failed UDM-related operation with optional parameter overrides.

transaction_id.description: Identifier of the failed transaction or operation.

override_parameters.description: Optional parameters to adjust behavior for the retry.

target_udm_node_id.description: Override UDM node for the operation.

reason.description: Reason or comment explaining why a retry is requested.

functions.returns: Updated transaction status, new attempt metadata, and final outcome of the retry if executed synchronously.

functions.name: get_subscriber_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve an audit trail of subscriber-related operations and changes in UDM/UDR.

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber identifier for which to retrieve audit logs.

filters.description: Filter options for narrowing down the audit log.

functions.returns: Paginated list of audit events including timestamps, operation types, initiators, and snapshots of changed fields.

functions.name: search_udm_subscriber_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across udm_subscriber entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching udm_subscriber entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_udm_subscriber_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N udm_subscriber records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_udm_subscriber_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many udm_subscriber records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_udm_subscriber_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many udm_subscriber records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_udm_subscriber_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of udm_subscriber data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_udm_subscriber_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a udm_subscriber dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_udm_subscriber_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more udm_subscriber entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_udm_subscriber_snapshot
functions.description: Restore udm_subscriber state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_udm_subscriber_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the udm_subscriber workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_udm_subscriber_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across udm_subscriber metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_udm_subscriber_audit_events
functions.description: Search the udm_subscriber audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_udm_subscriber_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers udm_subscriber workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_udm_subscriber_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for udm_subscriber events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_udm_subscriber_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for udm_subscriber events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_udm_subscriber_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off udm_subscriber job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_udm_subscriber_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled udm_subscriber jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_udm_subscriber_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled udm_subscriber job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_udm_subscriber_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a udm_subscriber operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_udm_subscriber_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a udm_subscriber action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_udm_subscriber_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a udm_subscriber approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_udm_subscriber_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any udm_subscriber entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_udm_subscriber_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a udm_subscriber entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_udm_subscriber_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling udm_subscriber behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_udm_subscriber_policies
functions.description: List udm_subscriber policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_udm_subscriber_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two udm_subscriber-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_udm_subscriber_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a udm_subscriber entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_udm_subscriber_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many udm_subscriber entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
